Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

DATA SHEET FOR SELECTION OF 

WEIGHING-CUM-TIPPING/BAG FILLING MACHINES 

FOR BULK HANDLING 



1. Scope— Lays down the data required for the selection of weighing-cum-tipping/bag filling 
machines for bulk handling. 

2. Data Sheet

2.6 Remarks 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This Indian Standard lays down the data required for the selection of weighing-curn-tipping/ 
bag filling machines. This data sheet may be used by manufacturer for giving details of the 
equipment being manufactured by them. This data sheet may also be used by purchaser for giving 
details to the manufacturer/supplier of the equipment being required by him. This data sheet may 
also be used by purchaser to collect information from manufacturers to enable him to make a 
proper selection of weighing-cum-tipping/bag filling machines. 

3
